title: automation: the sys_connector_connection status description, the markReconnectRequired docblock and reconnectRequiredReason all say reconnect_required means the authorization server refused the grant; three other paths set it
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ① defects with named locations, found by the #28614 dev (report 6567285836, out_of_scope_findings a and b) while correcting the same claim in `@objectstack/spec` (PR #28862). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it and the lane.
Reader: the owner of `packages/services/service-automation` and `packages/platform-objects` (likely `domain:server`); not `domain:spec`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `reconnectRequiredReason`, `markReconnectRequired` docblock, `sys_connector_connection status` → only #28614 (the spec JSDoc, a different file).
reach: an admin reading a stored `status_reason`, or the connection object's field help, is told the authorization server refused the grant when it was never asked.

## Where (on `main`)

1. `packages/platform-objects/.../sys-connector-connection.object.ts` ≈L98: the `status` field description says `reconnect_required` means the authorization server refused the grant.
2. `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-connections.ts`: the `ConnectorConnectionStore#markReconnectRequired` docblock carries the same narrow claim.
3. `packages/services/service-automation/src/oauth2-grant/grant-handle.ts` ≈L123: `reconnectRequiredReason` opens with "its authorization server refused the grant". `refreshOnce` reuses it on the no-refresh-token path (≈L267) and the no-client path (≈L271), where no server was asked. So the stored `statusReason` first claims a refusal and only then states the real cause.

## What is true

`reconnect_required` is set four ways: a refresh refused by the authorization server; no refresh token was issued; the connection keeps no client to refresh with; and the upstream refused the connection's token at MCP tool discovery (PR #28598, `plugin.ts`). PR #28862 words the spec contract this way.

## Done when

Items 1 and 2 describe all four causes, as the spec JSDoc does after PR #28862. Item 3's reason names the cause that actually happened on each path, and a test pins the no-refresh-token and no-client reasons.
